summary: The forward DFA search could rerun its prefix prefilter while a match was pending, skipping ahead and allowing a later match to overwrite it. For (?:ab|c)*c on cabac, the upstream regression test expects pattern 0 ending at offset 1. The fix permits this prefilter scan only when mat.is_none(), preserving the pending match while its priority is resolved. Reverse the DFA implementation hunk and retain the test added by this commit, in regex-automata's integration target with default features. No tests were executed.
